predecessors.name: Southern Qi
predecessors.text: the Southern Qi shape of 500 without Shouyang, which Pei Shuye surrendered to the Wei in 500

successors.name: Chen dynasty
successors.text: the Jiangnan, Hunan and Lingnan rump that Chen Baxian took in 557

successors.name: Western Wei
successors.text: Xiangyang (550), Hanzhong; Yi Province went to the Western Wei in 553 after Xiao Ji's fall

successors.name: Northern Qi
successors.text: the northeastern provinces north of the Yangtze, approximated as Anhui and Jiangsu within the Liang shape minus the Jiangnan (south-bank) region

ledger.x: 502: Xiao Yan takes the throne from Emperor He of the Southern Qi and founds the Liang.
503: Yi Province (Sichuan) comes over.
504: the Wei take the border cities.
504: Yiyang falls to the Wei.
505: Nanzheng and Hanzhong go to the Wei.
506: Wei Rui takes Hefei.
507: the Wei are beaten at Zhongli.
525: Pengcheng is surrendered to Liang.
525: Pengcheng is given back.
526: Shouyang falls to Liang.
529: Liang's client Yuan Hao takes Luoyang.
529: Luoyang is lost again.
535: Lan Qin conquers Hanzhong.
544: Lý Bôn proclaims himself emperor in Jiaozhou.
545: Liang forces retake the Vietnamese lowlands.
547: Hou Jing brings over the provinces south of the Yellow River.
548: Hou Jing rebels against Liang.
548: Hou Jing's rebellion reaches the capital.
548: Hou Jing takes Shouyang by ambush.
549: Jiankang falls to Hou Jing.
549: Hou Jing holds Zhejiang.
549: the northeast beyond the Yangtze submits to Eastern Wei.
550: Xiangyang goes to the Western Wei's side.
550: Liang forces leave the Vietnamese lowlands.
552: Hou Jing is destroyed.
552: Xiao Ji claims the throne in Yi Province.
552: Zhejiang and the capital region return to Liang.
552: Xiao Yi takes the imperial title and stays at Jiangling.
553: Hanzhong goes to the Western Wei with Sichuan.
555: the Liang court is at Jiankang again under Wang Sengbian.
555: Western Wei sacks Jiangling, kills Emperor Yuan and sets up Xiao Cha.
557: Chen Baxian ends the Liang and founds the Chen.

wars.name: Liang-Northern Wei war of 503-507
wars.outcome: The Wei take Yiyang (504) and Nanzheng (505); Wei Rui takes Hefei (506) and beats the Wei at Zhongli (spring 507).

wars.name: Liang advance to Pengcheng, 525
wars.outcome: Yuan Faseng surrenders Pengcheng in spring 525; Xiao Zong gives it back in summer, ending Liang's advances in the northeast.

wars.name: Chen Qingzhi's expedition and Yuan Hao's occupation of Luoyang
wars.outcome: Yuan Hao, made Prince of Wei by Liang in winter 528, takes Luoyang in 529 and is thrown out by Erzhu Rong; Chen Qingzhi flees back to Liang.

wars.name: Lan Qin's conquest of Hanzhong
wars.outcome: Lan Qin conquers Hanzhong and forces the Western Wei to sue for peace.

wars.name: Lý Bôn's rebellion and the Liang reoccupation of Jiaozhou
wars.outcome: Lý Bôn rebels in 541 and proclaims himself emperor in 544; Liang forces were 'not driven out until 550'.

wars.name: Hou Jing's rebellion
wars.outcome: Hou Jing defects in 547, rebels in summer 548, takes Jiankang in spring 549 and proclaims the Han in November 551; Chen Baxian and Wang Sengbian destroy him in May 552.

wars.name: Xiao Yi's war with Xiao Ji and the Western Wei conquest of Yi Province
wars.outcome: Xiao Yi has Xiao Ji put to death; the Western Wei capture his domain, 'permanently lost' to Liang.

wars.name: Western Wei conquest of Jiangling
wars.outcome: Yuwen Tai's attack of winter 554 takes Jiangling; Emperor Yuan is put to death in January 555 and Xiao Cha set up.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line on any page opened.
